name: Views Porter Stemmer
description: A Views filter plugin that applies Porter stemming (ignores suffixes/plurals) to text searches.
project_description:
This module adds stemming support to these Views filters:

 
 String 
 Combine 
 Views Autocomplete Filters extensions of both String and Combine
 
 The Search API filters are not supported, as Search API already has equivalent functionality. 
 
 
 
 By default, stemming is off and can be turned in on the filter's exposed options.

 Only some languages support stemming. For an up-to-date list of supported languages, see the upstream library .
